relation_notes.increases: subject raises a quantity of the object; direction subject -> object
relation_notes.decreases: subject lowers a quantity of the object; direction subject -> object
relation_notes.causes: reserved for explicit causal wording in the source; do not infer causation from co-occurrence
relation_notes.associated_with: the source states co-occurrence only; the safe fallback when nothing else fits
relation_notes.correlates_with: use only when the source reports a correlation statistic
relation_notes.outperforms: subject beats a named baseline; put that baseline in object or conditions
relation_notes.measured_by: object is the metric or instrument; subject is the thing measured
relation_notes.evaluated_on: object is the dataset or benchmark; subject is the method being evaluated

evidence_roles.direct: the span alone entails the assertion
evidence_roles.supporting: the span carries part of the assertion; a second span supplies the rest
evidence_roles.contradicting: the span conflicts with the assertion; ship both and flag the conflict
evidence_roles.inferred: the assertion needs reasoning beyond the quoted span

confidence_levels.direct_verbatim: exact or whitespace-normalised span, direct role, no hedge in the wording
confidence_levels.direct_reported: verbatim span of a reported result, including hedged or attributed wording
confidence_levels.inferred: needs two or more premises; list the premises in evidence
confidence_levels.aggregated: several spans jointly support one assertion, none of them sufficient alone
confidence_levels.ambiguous: only fuzzy matches, or spans that conflict; never present as fact
confidence_levels.unsupported: no locatable span; the assertion must not ship as a finding

run_status.success: every shipped assertion locates verbatim and clears the lint gate
run_status.partial: some pages or claims are degraded; the limits are named in uncertainty
run_status.unsupported: the material cannot support assertions at the requested granularity
run_status.failed: the pipeline could not read the material or could not write the result

match_methods.exact: the quote occurs character-for-character in the page text
match_methods.normalized: the quote occurs after whitespace / hyphen / ligature normalisation
match_methods.fuzzy: similar but not verbatim; must never be labelled a quote
match_methods.unverified: not found; the assertion is blocked
